text: When this happened before you were able to go back in and use an old version

author: Harvey Davis
text:
Not being compatible does not mean it doesn’t work, just that alarms may not work.

I bought a Galaxy S22 instead of the S23 because of what the compatibility chart said. My S22 was compatible for a month and then gor the next 10 months. 

You can take a look in the Help Safety section in the phone on compatibility and their website.  In my experience the time it takes  for a phone/compatibility is not predictable.

Just be watchful on the alarms when the blood sugar is outside the range to confirm whether the alarms are going off as expected.
